packs.name: Starter
packs.tagline: First install on a small router.
packs.description: A light ads, tracker, and telemetry base plus the Mini threat feed. The smallest useful setup for a router with limited RAM.
packs.notes: Good for a first install or a low-power router. It will not block every ad or tracker; move to Balanced when the box has headroom.

packs.name: Balanced
packs.description: Ads, trackers, telemetry, malware, and scams. A good default for a home network that does not want to babysit allowlists.
packs.overlap_note: TIF Medium overlaps about 26% with the base list because the base already covers common threat domains; the remaining 74% is new.
packs.notes: TIF Medium trades some threat coverage for memory. On a router with limited free RAM, use Starter instead. About a quarter of TIF Medium overlaps the base list; the rest adds live threat domains.

packs.name: Strict
packs.tagline: Maximum blocking on a server-class box.
packs.description: The most aggressive Multi tier plus the full threat feed. For people who prefer to allowlist the occasional broken site.
packs.overlap_note: TIF full overlaps about 26% with Ultimate because the base already covers common threat domains; the remaining 74% adds live threat domains.
packs.notes: About 2.1M rules; AGH needs a box with plenty of RAM. Expect to allowlist apps, share links, and some analytics. Not for a small router.

packs.name: Security
packs.description: Malware, phishing, and scam domains from the Medium threat feed and a live phishing list. No ad or tracker blocking.
packs.notes: Use this when ads are acceptable but malicious domains are not. Pair it with any ad-blocking list you already run.

packs.name: Family
packs.description: A light base with adult, gambling, and threat blocking. Intended for a household network where those categories should not resolve.
packs.notes: Adult and gambling blocking can catch health and education sites. Review the allowlist if something legitimate stops resolving.

packs.name: Privacy
packs.tagline: Native device trackers on phones and PCs.
packs.description: Android, Apple, and Windows/Office native tracker lists. This is an add-on pack: pair it with Starter or Balanced if you also want ads and trackers blocked.
packs.notes: Device-specific lists can break app features and updates. Start with one device list and add the others only if you need them.

packs.name: Smart home
packs.description: Smart TV and vendor tracker lists for Samsung, LG, Roku, and Amazon. This is an add-on pack: pair it with Starter or Balanced if you also want ads.
packs.notes: TV apps and firmware updates may stop working. Keep the vendor list you actually own; remove the others to reduce rule count.
